params.body:
The Studio follows who may change a piece (pipeline PR alongside), and the byline is set in the piece line.

- A team piece someone else wrote opens to read: the text is read-only, Save and Delete are gone, the rail's buttons are disabled and the automatic suggestions do not run. One line says who wrote it and that Discuss is where to say what should change. Admins edit every piece.
- The piece line ends in "by …": the author's own name or "Trendwolves Editorial Team".

Builds on #30 (contains its commit), so merge #30 first or this one alone. Build ok.
params.title: Studio: who may change a piece, and the byline
